title: Supplier invoice reconciliation
outcome: For a stated period and scope, reconcile every supplier bill in the customer's QuickBooks Online company against its purchase order (two-way match), and deliver reconciled records, discrepancy exceptions, an evidence package and an export.

source.accessNote: QuickBooks Online offers no read-only accounting scope: the OAuth credential (com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting) can technically write. get-it's connector exposes no mutation method, issues only HTTP GET queries and reads, and refuses any mutation intent before any request is sent. No write, payment or email action is performed by this contract.

inputs.note: a bill or purchase order without a CurrencyRef is in the home currency; review thresholds apply only in the home currency

requirements.expiresNoLaterThan: end of the order's correction window

matching.lineLink: A bill line is matched to the purchase-order line named by its LinkedTxn (TxnType PurchaseOrder, TxnLineId). Without a TxnLineId, it is matched to the single line of the linked purchase order with the same item; zero or several candidates is po_line_ambiguous.
matching.accountBasedLines: An account-based line (no item, quantity or unit price) is compared as quantity 1 at a unit price equal to its amount.
matching.totalBasis: pre-tax line total: the sum of the bill's line amounts is compared with the sum of (bill quantity x purchase-order unit price) over its matched lines. Tax is reported, not compared.
matching.cumulative: Over-billing is computed across the bills in the same source snapshot only, in (TxnDate, Id) order.
matching.duplicates: Bills from the same vendor with the same DocNumber (trimmed, case-insensitive) are duplicates; without a DocNumber, the same vendor, TxnDate and total.

unitPrice.text: the greater of $1 or 1% of the PO unit price, per line

invoiceTotal.text: the greater of $5 or 0.5% of the expected total

amountAtStake.price_variance: |bill unit price - PO unit price| x bill quantity
amountAtStake.quantity_variance: |bill quantity - PO quantity| x PO unit price
amountAtStake.po_overbilled: quantity (or amount) billed beyond the PO line, at the PO unit price

review.approval: one person approval of the exact delivery packet digest by an operator who did not request the review; agents and services cannot approve; a re-run produces a new packet and needs a new approval
review.customerDecisions: the customer resolves or approves ambiguous business decisions (exception types marked decision: customer); a decision is recorded and never changes the source system

acceptanceCriteria.test: every in-scope bill of the source snapshot has exactly one reconciled record, and no record names a bill outside it
every record and exception cites source records whose digests are in the snapshot manifest
recomputing the reconciliation from the snapshot and the contract gives the delivered records and exceptions exactly
a record's status agrees with its variances under the contract tolerances
every connector invocation for the order is an observation, and no mutation was attempted
every exception that requires review is covered by a person approval of the delivered packet's digest
deliverables were published no later than the turnaround deadline

calendar.businessDays: Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays (observed dates: a Saturday holiday is observed the Friday before, a Sunday holiday the Monday after), in the customer's time zone
holidays: Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.

service.turnaroundStarts: when the order is accepted for fulfillment and every required input and access is complete, whichever is later
service.deadline: the end (23:59:59.999, customer time zone) of the Nth counted business day after the start date
service.customerBlocked: a business day on which the order is blocked by the customer at any time does not count toward the turnaround

commercial.invoicesCounted: in-scope bills in the source snapshot

charging.partial: charged only when the customer accepts the completed portion, by the same pricing on the number of invoices accepted
charging.cancelled: not charged, unless the customer accepts a completed portion (charged as partial)
